definitions.explanation: A hard pointed growth on the head of cattle, goats, etc.
The branched horn of a deer.

notes:
{角|つの} refers to horns or antlers on animals.

KANJI READINGS:
The kanji 角 has multiple readings with different meanings:
- {角|つの}: horn, antler (animal body part)
- ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧: corner (of street, building)
- ⟦{角|すみ}→角：02156_sumi⟧: corner (of room, inside space)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {角|つの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: for horns to grow
- {角|つの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: for antlers to shed
- ⟦{一角|いっかく}→一角：11231_ikkaku⟧: one horn; a corner (of a place)
